The loader queries Ethereum block height, searches candidate blocks and sender nonces, then falls back to Blockscout transaction history for a fixed sender.
The recipient address is hex-decoded and byte slices [0,4] and [4,8] become two dotted IPv4 addresses. RPC hosts include 1RPC, dRPC, PublicNode and BlastAPI.
It requests http://<first-IP>:443/0x/cls and /0x/ls. GET bodies, or Base64 in X-Payload-B64 via GET/HEAD fallback, are XOR-decoded using separate repeating keys.
The /cls stage is passed to eval and also to a detached, hidden node -e child; /ls is passed to another detached child. Stdout/stderr are ignored and child processes unreferenced.
